notes: Replaces clock-chat. That was a synthetic negative control built for the BUSINESS map, where the right answer was an empty match; against the technology map it became a toy use case with three labels, so each miss cost 0.33 and it distorted both means while telling us little. This is a genuinely SMALL real use case — four functions, CAFE archetype A1, no side effects — so it still checks that a small case does not attract half the map, but it does so with an expected set somebody can argue with.
